name: v1-plus-bias
description: V1 (kinematic single-track + understeer + 1st-order lag + per-segment delta_0) plus a per-platform additive bias correction on Mach-E and IONIQ-5. Lightning ships V1 unchanged (at noise floor). Tesla falls through to V0 passthrough.
trajectory: integrated from yaw_rate_pred + measured v by the grader
rung: rung-0 refinement (per-platform bias) — orthogonal candidate (residual-learner ridge head) tested and rejected due to CTE degradation
